function setupMovableSort(a){
 let selected=null,dragged=null;
 const zones=[...document.querySelectorAll(&#x27;[data-bin]&#x27;)];
 function moveCard(i,bin){answers[key(&#x27;sort&#x27;+i)]=bin;persist();selected=null;paint();el(&#x27;feedback&#x27;).textContent=&#x27;&#x27;}
 function paint(){
  zones.forEach(z=&gt;z.replaceChildren());
  a.words.forEach((w,i)=&gt;{
   const bin=answers[key(&#x27;sort&#x27;+i)]||&#x27;&#x27;;
   const zone=zones.find(z=&gt;z.dataset.bin===bin)||zones[0];
   const card=document.createElement(&#x27;button&#x27;);card.type=&#x27;button&#x27;;card.className=&#x27;word-card&#x27;+(selected===i?&#x27; selected&#x27;:&#x27;&#x27;);
   card.draggable=true;card.textContent=w;card.setAttribute(&#x27;aria-label&#x27;,w+&#x27;; &#x27;+(bin||&#x27;unsorted&#x27;)+&#x27;; select to move&#x27;);
   card.addEventListener(&#x27;click&#x27;,()=&gt;{selected=selected===i?null:i;paint()});
   card.addEventListener(&#x27;dragstart&#x27;,e=&gt;{dragged=i;e.dataTransfer.setData(&#x27;text/plain&#x27;,String(i));e.dataTransfer.effectAllowed=&#x27;move&#x27;;card.classList.add(&#x27;dragging&#x27;)});
   card.addEventListener(&#x27;dragend&#x27;,()=&gt;{dragged=null;zones.forEach(z=&gt;z.classList.remove(&#x27;drag-over&#x27;))});
   zone.appendChild(card);
  });
 }
 zones.forEach(z=&gt;{
  z.addEventListener(&#x27;click&#x27;,e=&gt;{if(e.target.closest(&#x27;.word-card&#x27;))return;if(selected!==null)moveCard(selected,z.dataset.bin)});
  z.addEventListener(&#x27;keydown&#x27;,e=&gt;{if((e.key===&#x27;Enter&#x27;||e.key===&#x27; &#x27;)&amp;&amp;selected!==null){e.preventDefault();moveCard(selected,z.dataset.bin)}});

  z.addEventListener(&#x27;dragleave&#x27;,()=&gt;z.classList.remove(&#x27;drag-over&#x27;));
  z.addEventListener(&#x27;drop&#x27;,e=&gt;{e.preventDefault();z.classList.remove(&#x27;drag-over&#x27;);const n=Number(e.dataTransfer.getData(&#x27;text/plain&#x27;));if(Number.isInteger(n)&amp;&amp;n&gt;=0&amp;&amp;n&lt;a.words.length)moveCard(n,z.dataset.bin)});
 });
 el(&#x27;check&#x27;).onclick=()=&gt;{
  const assigned=a.words.filter((w,i)=&gt;!!answers[key(&#x27;sort&#x27;+i)]).length;
  if(assigned&lt;a.words.length){el(&#x27;feedback&#x27;).textContent=&#x27;Place all &#x27;+a.words.length+&#x27; cards before checking (&#x27;+assigned+&#x27; placed).&#x27;;return}

 };

}

const canvas=document.getElementById(&#x27;wheel&#x27;), ctx=canvas.getContext(&#x27;2d&#x27;);
const ta=document.getElementById(&#x27;entries&#x27;), winner=document.getElementById(&#x27;winner&#x27;);
let entries=[], angle=0, spinning=false;
const balloonLayer=document.getElementById(&#x27;balloon-layer&#x27;);
function clearBalloons(){ balloonLayer.replaceChildren(); }
function celebrateWinner(){
  clearBalloons();
  const colors=[&#x27;#b85c2a&#x27;,&#x27;#e9b85d&#x27;,&#x27;#91a78c&#x27;,&#x27;#f5dfb9&#x27;];
  for(let i=0;i&lt;22;i++){
    const b=document.createElement(&#x27;span&#x27;);
    b.className=&#x27;celebration-balloon&#x27;;
    b.style.left=(3+Math.random()*94)+&#x27;%&#x27;;
    b.style.setProperty(&#x27;--balloon-color&#x27;,colors[i%colors.length]);
    b.style.setProperty(&#x27;--drift&#x27;,(-90+Math.random()*180)+&#x27;px&#x27;);
    b.style.setProperty(&#x27;--duration&#x27;,(4.5+Math.random()*1.5)+&#x27;s&#x27;);
    b.style.animationDelay=(Math.random()*.7)+&#x27;s&#x27;;
    balloonLayer.appendChild(b);
    b.addEventListener(&#x27;animationend&#x27;,()=&gt;b.remove(),{once:true});
  }
}

function getEntries(){ return ta.value.split(/[\n,]+/).map(x=&gt;x.trim()).filter(Boolean); }
const entryStatus=document.getElementById(&#x27;entry-status&#x27;),giftStage=document.getElementById(&#x27;gift-stage&#x27;),giftMessage=document.getElementById(&#x27;gift-message&#x27;);
let giftTimer;
function resetGift(){clearTimeout(giftTimer);giftStage.classList.remove(&#x27;unwrapping&#x27;);giftMessage.textContent=&#x27;A premium collectible surprise. Still under wraps.&#x27;;}
function unwrapGift(preview=false){resetGift();void giftStage.offsetWidth;giftStage.classList.add(&#x27;unwrapping&#x27;);giftMessage.textContent=preview?&#x27;A little preview. The surprise stays hidden.&#x27;:&#x27;One teacher. A premium surprise. Congratulations!&#x27;;}
function lockControls(locked){for(const id of [&#x27;entries&#x27;,&#x27;load&#x27;,&#x27;reset&#x27;,&#x27;preview-gift&#x27;])document.getElementById(id).disabled=locked;document.getElementById(&#x27;spin&#x27;).disabled=locked||entries.length&lt;2;}
function randomIndex(n){const x=new Uint32Array(1),limit=Math.floor(4294967296/n)*n;do{crypto.getRandomValues(x);}while(x[0]&gt;=limit);return x[0]%n;}

function draw(){
  const n=Math.max(entries.length,1), cx=350, cy=350, r=315;
  ctx.clearRect(0,0,700,700);
  const slice=2*Math.PI/n;
  for(let i=0;i&lt;n;i++){
    const a=angle+i*slice;
    ctx.beginPath(); ctx.moveTo(cx,cy); ctx.arc(cx,cy,r,a,a+slice); ctx.closePath();
    ctx.fillStyle=i%2===0 ? &#x27;#b85c2a&#x27; : &#x27;#e9a66f&#x27;; ctx.fill();
    ctx.strokeStyle=&#x27;#fff&#x27;; ctx.lineWidth=3; ctx.stroke();
    ctx.save(); ctx.translate(cx,cy); ctx.rotate(a+slice/2);
    ctx.textAlign=&#x27;right&#x27;; ctx.fillStyle=&#x27;#fff&#x27;; ctx.font=&#x27;bold 28px Arial&#x27;;
    ctx.fillText(entries[i],r-25,10); ctx.restore();
  }
  ctx.beginPath(); ctx.arc(cx,cy,62,0,2*Math.PI); ctx.fillStyle=&#x27;#4b2d20&#x27;; ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle=&#x27;#fff&#x27;; ctx.font=&#x27;bold 20px Arial&#x27;; ctx.textAlign=&#x27;center&#x27;; ctx.fillText(&#x27;DRAW&#x27;,cx,7+cy);
}
function load(){
 if(spinning)return;
 clearBalloons();resetGift();winner.textContent=&#x27;&#x27;;
 const list=getEntries();const valid=list.every(x=&gt;/^\d+$/.test(x));const unique=new Set(list.map(x=&gt;x.replace(/^0+(?=\d)/,&#x27;&#x27;))).size===list.length;

 entryStatus.textContent=!valid?&#x27;Use entry numbers only.&#x27;:!unique?&#x27;Remove duplicate entry numbers before drawing.&#x27;:entries.length?entries.length+&#x27; entries loaded.&#x27;:&#x27;Load at least two validated entry numbers to begin.&#x27;;

}
function spin(){
  if(spinning || entries.length&lt;2) return;
  spinning=true; lockControls(true);resetGift();clearBalloons();winner.textContent=&#x27;&#x27;;
  const start=angle, chosen=randomIndex(entries.length), slice=2*Math.PI/entries.length, target=-Math.PI/2-(chosen+.5)*slice, turn=2*Math.PI;
  const extra=turn*6+((target-angle)%turn+turn)%turn, duration=4200, t0=performance.now();
  function anim(t){
    const p=Math.min((t-t0)/duration,1), ease=1-Math.pow(1-p,3);
    angle=start+extra*ease; draw();
    if(p&lt;1) requestAnimationFrame(anim);
    else{
      spinning=false;
      const n=entries.length, slice=2*Math.PI/n;
      let normalized=(((-Math.PI/2-angle)%(2*Math.PI))+2*Math.PI)%(2*Math.PI);
      let idx=Math.floor(normalized/slice)%n;
      winner.textContent=&#x27;🎉 Winning entry: &#x27;+entries[idx]+&#x27; 🎉&#x27;;
      celebrateWinner();lockControls(false);unwrapGift(false);
    }
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(anim);
}
